segments.name: Global Architectural Coatings
segments.description: Supplies decorative paints, coatings, adhesives, sealants and related products to painting contractors and consumers for residential and commercial buildings.
segments.evidence: This reportable business segment primarily supplies a variety of decorative coatings, adhesives, sealants and finishes along with paint strippers, stains and related chemicals.

segments.name: Performance Coatings
segments.description: Supplies protective coatings, sealants, transparencies, paint films and pavement marking products to aftermarket, aerospace, marine and infrastructure customers.
segments.evidence: This reportable business segment primarily supplies a variety of protective coatings, adhesives, sealants and finishes along with pavement marking products and related chemicals, transparencies and paint films.

segments.name: Industrial Coatings
segments.description: Supplies protective and decorative coatings, adhesives, sealants, metal pretreatments and specialty products directly to original equipment manufacturers and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: This reportable business segment primarily supplies a variety of protective and decorative coatings and finishes along with adhesives, sealants, metal pretreatment products, optical monomers and coatings, low-friction coatings and other specialty products.

revenueModel.text: PPG earns revenue by selling paints, coatings and specialty products directly to manufacturers, contractors, distributors, retailers and consumers.
revenueModel.evidence: PPG supplies paints, coatings and specialty products to customers serving a wide array of end-uses, including industrial equipment and components; packaging material; aircraft and marine equipment; automotive original equipment; automotive refinish and aftermarket; pavement marking products; as well as coatings for other industrial and consumer products.
